source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 6 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein teen cheezein sambhalni hain: \(\tan^{-1}\) ke saamne 2, do mukhtalif inverse functions, aur jawab \(\cos^{-1}\) mein.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\) aur \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4}\).
Find kya karna hai? Jama \(\cos^{-1}\frac{36}{85}\) dikhana hai.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\), phir triangles se \(\cos^{-1}\) shakal, phir formula (iii).
Plan: teen saaf qadam: 2 hatao, dono ko \(\cos^{-1}\) banao, jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\) aur \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4}\).
Maloom karna (prove): in ka jama \(\cos^{-1}\frac{36}{85}\) hai.
Tareeqa: (1) double formula \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\) se \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4}\) ko ek akela \(\tan^{-1}\) banayenge; (2) dono angles ko \(\cos^{-1}\) shakal mein likhenge, kyunke jawab \(\cos^{-1}\) mein hai; (3) formula (iii) se jama karenge.

2 ko hatayein
\[2\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{4}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{2 \cdot \frac{1}{4}}{1 - \frac{1}{16}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{1/2}{15/16} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{8}{15}\]
Kyun: double formula \(-1 < x < 1\) par sahi hai, aur \(x = \frac{1}{4}\) is mein aata hai. Upar \(2 \cdot \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\), neeche \(1 - \frac{1}{16} = \frac{15}{16}\). Fraction se divide yani ulta kar ke multiply: \(\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{16}{15} = \frac{8}{15}\).
Dhyan dein: \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4}\) ko \(\tan^{-1}\frac{2}{4}\) likhna bilkul ghalat hai; 2 angle ko double karta hai, number ko nahi.

\(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\) ko \(\cos^{-1}\) mein badlein
\[\alpha = \sin^{-1}\tfrac{3}{5}\]
\[\cos\alpha = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{9}{25}} = \tfrac{4}{5}\]
\[\alpha = \cos^{-1}\tfrac{4}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha\) pehle quadrant mein hai (sine positive), wahan cosine bhi positive. Triangle: opposite 3, hypotenuse 5, adjacent 4.

\(\tan^{-1}\frac{8}{15}\) ko \(\cos^{-1}\) mein badlein
\[\beta = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{8}{15}:\ \text{opposite } 8,\ \text{adjacent } 15\]
\[\text{hypotenuse} = \sqrt{8^{2} + 15^{2}} = 17\]
\[\cos\beta = \tfrac{15}{17},\quad \beta = \cos^{-1}\tfrac{15}{17}\]
Kyun: \(\tan\beta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}} = \frac{8}{15}\). Pythagoras se hypotenuse \(\sqrt{64 + 225} = \sqrt{289} = 17\). Phir \(\cos\beta = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{15}{17}\). \(\beta\) pehle quadrant mein hai, is liye sab ratios positive.

Formula (iii) lagayein, \(x = \frac{4}{5},\ y = \frac{15}{17}\)
\[\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \tfrac{3}{5},\quad \sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \tfrac{8}{17}\]
\[\text{L.H.S} = \cos^{-1}\left(\tfrac{4}{5}\cdot\tfrac{15}{17} - \tfrac{3}{5}\cdot\tfrac{8}{17}\right)\]
\[= \cos^{-1}\left(\tfrac{60}{85} - \tfrac{24}{85}\right) = \cos^{-1}\tfrac{36}{85}\]
\[= \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: roots wohi sines hain: \(\sin\alpha = \frac{3}{5}\), \(\sin\beta = \frac{8}{17}\). Cosine ke jama mein \(xy\) minus sines ka product. Denominator \(5 \times 17 = 85\); numerators \(4 \times 15 = 60\) aur \(3 \times 8 = 24\); farq 36.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin^{-1}0.6 + 2\tan^{-1}0.25 \approx 0.6435 + 0.4900\]
\[= 1.1335\]
\[\cos^{-1}\tfrac{36}{85} \approx 1.1335\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) se dono taraf ek hi angle.
Teen qadmon wale sawal mein aisi tasdeeq sab se zaroori hai, kyunke har qadam par chhoti ghalti ka chance hota hai.
